data.one_liner: Turns text URLs and emails into clickable inline links in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides Linkify and SelectableLinkify widgets that automatically detect URLs and email addresses inside text strings and render them as clickable inline links. It supports custom styling, humanization options, and custom handling through callbacks.
use_when: You need to display standard text containing URLs or email addresses that users can tap to open.
You want selectable text with automatically linkified URLs and emails using SelectableLinkify.
avoid_when: You need a full-featured rich text editor rather than static display text.
You are parsing non-text formats that do not contain plain URLs or emails.
strengths: Supports both regular and selectable text widgets.
Allows custom linkifiers and fine-grained styling options for both links and non-links.
Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Requires a separate package like url_launcher to actually open links in the browser or OS.
Limited to URLs and emails by default unless custom linkifiers are provided.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and optionally add url_launcher to open links externally.
